admin: SELECT COUNT("inventory_lot"."id") FILTER (WHERE ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13' AND "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-12-13')) AS "expiring", COUNT("inventory_lot"."id") FILTER (WHERE "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-11-13') AS "expired" FROM "inventory_lot" WHERE "inventory_lot"."available_quantity" > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "catalog_product"."id" AS "col1" FROM "catalog_product" INNER JOIN "catalog_category" ON ("catalog_product"."category_id" = "catalog_category"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "inventory_lot" ON ("catalog_product"."id" = "inventory_lot"."product_id") WHERE ("catalog_category"."is_active" AND "catalog_product"."is_active") GROUP BY 1, "catalog_product"."minimum_stock" HAVING COALESCE(SUM("inventory_lot"."available_quantity") FILTER (WHERE ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13')), 0) <= ("catalog_product"."minimum_stock")) subquery

SELECT COUNT("sales_sale"."id") AS "sales_count", (CAST(COALESCE((CAST(SUM("sales_sale"."total_amount") AS NUMERIC)), (CAST('0' AS NUMERIC))) AS NUMERIC)) AS "sales_total", (CAST(COALESCE((CAST(SUM("sales_sale"."discount_amount") AS NUMERIC)), (CAST('0' AS NUMERIC))) AS NUMERIC)) AS "discount_total" FROM "sales_sale" WHERE django_datetime_cast_date("sales_sale"."confirmed_at", 'America/Lima', 'UTC') = '2026-11-13'
